description: Na₆BaO₄ crystallizes in the cubic I̅43m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one BaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with twelve NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one BaO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with five equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent BaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with twelve NaO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with five equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.71 Å. Ba is bonded to four O atoms to form BaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent BaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with twelve NaO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (2.51 Å) and three longer (2.54 Å) Ba-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to six Na and one Ba atom to form distorted OBaNa₆ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent OBaNa₆ pentagonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one OBa₄ tetrahedra, and edges with six equivalent OBaNa₆ pentagonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to four equivalent Ba atoms to form corner-sharing OBa₄ tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight Na atoms.
